entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Unbelievable. This is the third time I've called. Just connect me to a person already!
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Charlie, you can help me by taking back this piece of junk you sold me. This VeloBand is completely broken!
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

A technical fault? It's a disaster! The main reason I bought it, the pulse tracker, is completely not working. It's defective! It won't sync with the app, it just gives me an error. I want a refund, now!
Okay, I understand your frustration. It sounds like the pulse sensor isn't functioning correctly. Let me just pull up your account information.

You do that. And don't you dare try to 'troubleshoot' this with me. It's a defective product and I want my money back. If I don't get a return label by the end of this call, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. Is that clear?
I understand completely. I've got your order right here. I see you received the device just six days ago. Let me quickly review our return policy for you.
Okay, it looks like our policy states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery for a full refund.
Ninety days? Well, yeah, obviously I'm within that. So process the refund.

Absolutely. Since you are well within that 90-day window, I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately. I'm generating a prepaid return label and it will be in your email inbox in the next few minutes.
Oh. Okay. Well, that's what I wanted in the first place. Good. Send me the label.

The email has been sent. Just print out that label, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the defective unit, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Can I help you with anything else?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope you have a better rest of your day.
